datasets.name: Bijie landslide dataset
datasets.verbatim: In this study, we performed multilabel annotation on the Bijie landslide dataset, which is available online.1 ... 1[Online]. Available: https://github.com/caicaiw/Multi-label-Bijie-landslidedataset.git

methods.name: Swin-BiLSTM-FS (Swin transformer and BiLSTM-based feature sequence)
methods.summary: A multilabel classification network for landslide detection consisting of a feature representation (FR) module based on Swin transformer to extract feature maps and convert them into feature sequences, and a category relation parsing (CRP) module based on BiLSTM to model interlabel dependencies.
methods.source: Yongxin Li, Zhihui Xin, Guisheng Liao, Penghui Huang, and Mengting Yuan
methods.verbatim: In this study, a method combining Swin transformer and BiLSTM is proposed, called Swin-BiLSTM-FS (Swin transformer and BiLSTM-based feature sequence).

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is referenced and linked via a public repository, but the custom code for the Swin-BiLSTM-FS method is not available.
